evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-5-005 unit 15-125 (official), 480 m N. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHvm3): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
SE facing slope, 15 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Old Bella Bella, about 78 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.88975, -127.35264, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 4.6 km NE, on Clyakmain, Clyakwmain. Climb about 226 m, about 115 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2021 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-8, Region 5. Season: mule deer bucks Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 44, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
